Description: Verify standard user can login successfully
Preconditions: Application is loaded at https://www.saucedemo.com, Login page is displayed, Valid standard user credentials are available (standard_user / secret_sauce)
Steps: 1. Navigate to login page, 2. Enter username: 'standard_user', 3. Enter password: 'secret_sauce', 4. Click the Login button
Expected Result: User should be successfully logged in, Products page should be displayed, Page title should be 'Products', User should see the list of available products

Description: Verify login behavior for all user types (standard locked out problem performance glitch)
Preconditions: Application is loaded, Login page is displayed, Test data for various user types is available
Steps: 1. For each user type from data provider, 2. Navigate to login page, 3. Enter username and password, 4. Click Login button, 5. Verify the result based on shouldPass flag
Expected Result: For valid users: should navigate to Products page, For locked out users: should display error message, Error messages should be appropriate for each user type

Description: Verify error messages for invalid login attempts
Preconditions: Application is loaded, Login page is displayed, Test data with invalid credentials is available
Steps: 1. For each invalid login data set, 2. Enter invalid username, 3. Enter invalid password, 4. Click Login button, 5. Verify error message appears
Expected Result: Error message should be displayed, Error message should contain expected error text, User should remain on login page

Description: Verify locked out user cannot login
Preconditions: Application is loaded, Login page is displayed, Locked out user credentials are available (locked_out_user / secret_sauce)
Steps: 1. Navigate to login page, 2. Enter username: 'locked_out_user', 3. Enter password: 'secret_sauce', 4. Click Login button
Expected Result: Error message should be displayed, Error message should mention 'locked out', User should remain on login page

Description: Verify error can be closed after failed login
Preconditions: Application is loaded, Login page is displayed, An error message is displayed from a failed login attempt
Steps: 1. Attempt to login with empty credentials, 2. Verify error message is visible, 3. Click the error close button (X)
Expected Result: Error message should disappear, User should be able to re-enter credentials, Login form should be ready for new input

Description: Verify user can logout successfully
Preconditions: User is logged in successfully, Products page is displayed, Logout menu/button is available
Steps: 1. Login with valid credentials (standard_user / secret_sauce), 2. Verify user is on Products page, 3. Click on the hamburger menu, 4. Click 'Logout' option
Expected Result: User should be logged out, User should be redirected to login page, Session should be cleared

Description: Verify products page loads with correct title
Preconditions: User is logged in with valid credentials, Products page is accessible
Steps: 1. Login successfully, 2. Verify page loads, 3. Check page title
Expected Result: Products page should load, Page title should be 'Products'

Description: Verify all 6 products are displayed
Preconditions: User is logged in, Products page is loaded
Steps: 1. Count the total number of products displayed, 2. Verify the count
Expected Result: Exactly 6 products should be displayed

Description: Verify all product names are displayed
Preconditions: User is logged in, Products page is loaded
Steps: 1. Get all product names from the page, 2. Verify each product name is present
Expected Result: All 6 products should have their names displayed: Sauce Labs Backpack, Sauce Labs Bike Light, Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirt, Sauce Labs Fleece Jacket, Sauce Labs Onesie, Test.allTheThings() T-Shirt (Red)

Description: Verify all product prices are displayed and valid
Preconditions: User is logged in, Products page is loaded
Steps: 1. Get all product prices, 2. Verify each price is a positive number, 3. Verify count matches product count
Expected Result: All 6 products should have prices displayed, All prices should be greater than 0

Description: Verify products sort by Name A to Z
Preconditions: User is logged in, Products page is loaded
Steps: 1. Click the sort dropdown, 2. Select 'Name (A to Z)' option, 3. Get the sorted product names
Expected Result: Products should be sorted alphabetically A to Z, Each product should appear in correct order

Description: Verify products sort by Name Z to A
Preconditions: User is logged in, Products page is loaded
Steps: 1. Click the sort dropdown, 2. Select 'Name (Z to A)' option, 3. Get the sorted product names
Expected Result: Products should be sorted reverse alphabetically Z to A

Description: Verify products sort by Price Low to High
Preconditions: User is logged in, Products page is loaded
Steps: 1. Click the sort dropdown, 2. Select 'Price (low to high)' option, 3. Get the sorted prices
Expected Result: Products should be sorted by price in ascending order, Lowest priced product should appear first

Description: Verify products sort by Price High to Low
Preconditions: User is logged in, Products page is loaded
Steps: 1. Click the sort dropdown, 2. Select 'Price (high to low)' option, 3. Get the sorted prices
Expected Result: Products should be sorted by price in descending order, Highest priced product should appear first

Description: Verify adding single item to cart updates badge
Preconditions: User is logged in, Products page is loaded, Cart is empty (showing 0 or no badge)
Steps: 1. Verify cart is empty, 2. Click 'Add to Cart' button for Backpack, 3. Verify cart badge updates
Expected Result: Cart badge should show '1', Only one item should be in cart

Description: Verify adding multiple items to cart
Preconditions: User is logged in, Products page is loaded
Steps: 1. Click 'Add to Cart' for Backpack, 2. Click 'Add to Cart' for Bike Light, 3. Click 'Add to Cart' for Bolt T-Shirt, 4. Verify cart badge
Expected Result: Cart badge should show '3', All three items should be in cart

Description: Verify adding all 6 items to cart
Preconditions: User is logged in, Products page is loaded
Steps: 1. Add all 6 products to cart, 2. Verify cart badge
Expected Result: Cart badge should show '6', All 6 items should be in cart

Description: Verify removing item from cart on products page
Preconditions: User is logged in, Products page is loaded, Backpack is added to cart
Steps: 1. Add Backpack to cart, 2. Verify cart shows 1 item, 3. Click 'Remove' button for Backpack, 4. Verify cart badge updates
Expected Result: Cart should show 0 items, Backpack should be removed from cart, Remove button should change back to 'Add to Cart'

Description: Verify add and remove multiple items
Preconditions: User is logged in, Products page is loaded
Steps: 1. Add Backpack to cart, 2. Add Bike Light to cart, 3. Verify cart shows 2 items, 4. Remove Backpack from cart, 5. Verify cart shows 1 item
Expected Result: Cart should show correct count after each operation, Only Bike Light should remain in cart, Backpack button should show 'Add to Cart'

Description: Verify cart page loads correctly with empty cart
Preconditions: User is logged in, Products page is displayed, Cart is empty
Steps: 1. Click on cart icon, 2. Verify cart page loads, 3. Verify cart is empty
Expected Result: Should be on Cart page, Cart should show as empty, Item count should be 0

Description: Verify single item appears in cart with correct details
Preconditions: User is logged in, Products page is displayed
Steps: 1. Add Backpack to cart, 2. Navigate to cart, 3. Verify item details
Expected Result: Cart should contain 1 item, Item should be 'Sauce Labs Backpack', Price should be '$29.99', Quantity should be displayed

Description: Verify multiple items appear in cart
Preconditions: User is logged in, Products page is displayed
Steps: 1. Add three items to cart, 2. Navigate to cart, 3. Verify all items are present
Expected Result: Cart should show 3 items, All item names should be correct, All prices should be displayed

Description: Verify item can be removed from cart page
Preconditions: User is logged in, Cart contains 2 items
Steps: 1. Navigate to cart, 2. Click remove button for Backpack, 3. Verify cart updates
Expected Result: Cart should show 1 item, Backpack should be removed, Bike Light should remain

Description: Verify removing all items results in empty cart
Preconditions: User is logged in, Cart contains items
Steps: 1. Navigate to cart, 2. Remove all items one by one, 3. Verify cart is empty
Expected Result: Cart should be empty, Item count should be 0, Empty cart message should display

Description: Verify Continue Shopping returns to products page
Preconditions: User is logged in, User is on cart page with items
Steps: 1. Click 'Continue Shopping' button, 2. Verify navigation
Expected Result: Should navigate back to Products page, Cart items should be preserved

Description: Verify cart proceeds to checkout step one
Preconditions: User is logged in, User is on cart page with items
Steps: 1. Click 'Proceed to Checkout' button, 2. Verify checkout page loads
Expected Result: Should navigate to Checkout Step One, Customer information form should be displayed

Description: Verify checkout step one page loads correctly
Preconditions: User is logged in, Cart contains items, User has navigated to checkout
Steps: 1. Verify checkout page loads, 2. Verify step title
Expected Result: Should be on Checkout Step One page, Page title should contain 'Your Information', Form fields should be displayed

Description: Verify valid customer info proceeds to step two
Preconditions: User is on Checkout Step One, Valid customer data is available
Steps: 1. Enter first name, 2. Enter last name, 3. Enter postal code, 4. Click Continue button
Expected Result: Should proceed to Checkout Step Two (Overview), Customer information should be saved

Description: Verify error messages for missing checkout info
Preconditions: User is on Checkout Step One, Invalid/missing data is prepared
Steps: 1. Enter invalid/missing data, 2. Click Continue button, 3. Verify error message
Expected Result: Error message should be displayed, Should match expected error text, User should remain on Step One

Description: Verify all empty fields shows first name required error
Preconditions: User is on Checkout Step One, All fields are empty
Steps: 1. Leave all fields empty, 2. Click Continue button, 3. Verify error message
Expected Result: Error message should be displayed, Error should mention 'First Name is required'

Description: Verify cancel on step one returns to cart
Preconditions: User is on Checkout Step One
Steps: 1. Click Cancel button, 2. Verify navigation
Expected Result: Should return to cart page, Cart items should be preserved

Description: Verify checkout overview shows correct single item
Preconditions: User has filled in checkout Step One, User has 1 item in cart
Steps: 1. Verify on Step Two page, 2. Check item details in overview, 3. Verify pricing
Expected Result: Should be on Checkout Overview page, Overview should show 1 item, Item name should be 'Sauce Labs Backpack', Price should be '$29.99'

Description: Verify checkout overview shows correct multiple items
Preconditions: User has filled in checkout Step One, User has 3 items in cart
Steps: 1. Verify on Step Two page, 2. Check all items in overview
Expected Result: Should show 3 items, All item names should be correct, All prices should be displayed

Description: Verify subtotal calculation is correct for single item
Preconditions: User is on Checkout Step Two, Cart has 1 item (Backpack)
Steps: 1. Check subtotal amount, 2. Verify calculation
Expected Result: Subtotal should be $29.99

Description: Verify subtotal calculation is correct for multiple items
Preconditions: User is on Checkout Step Two, Cart has 3 items (Backpack Bike Light Onesie)
Steps: 1. Check subtotal amount, 2. Verify calculation (29.99 + 9.99 + 7.99 = 47.97)
Expected Result: Subtotal should equal sum of all item prices, Subtotal should be $47.97

Description: Verify tax is calculated correctly
Preconditions: User is on Checkout Step Two, Subtotal is calculated
Steps: 1. Get subtotal amount, 2. Get tax amount, 3. Verify tax calculation (approximately 8%)
Expected Result: Tax should be calculated as 8% of subtotal, Tax calculation should be accurate within 0.02 margin
